title: Trader decisions and rejections and deferrals and interventions become learning evidence

register_row: docs/operations/problem-register.md RC4 table, Agora row (SD_AGORA_SERVANT_CORE_2026-11-27.md §7.3, §12 T4)

changes.services/control-plane/bff/agora/dataset: Added InteractionKind.DECISION ('decision'), InteractionKind.REJECTION ('rejection'), InteractionKind.DEFERRAL ('deferral'), and InteractionKind.INTERVENTION ('intervention') routed to DatasetKind.LEARN in _KIND_TO_DATASET, plus DECISION_EVIDENCE_KINDS and DECISION_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_BUDGET constants.
changes.services/agora/shadow_mode.py: Added decision_evidence_kind() and build_decision_time_snapshot() and included evidence_kind and decision_time_snapshot on every immutable Agora decision lock built by build_decision_lock() under its canonical checksum.
changes.services/control-plane/bff/agora/dataset: Added classify_decision_evidence_kind(), build_decision_time_snapshot(), snapshot_observation_vector(), normalize_decision_evidence_content(), build_decision_lock_evidence_request(), build_journal_entry_evidence_request(), extract_decision_lock_evidence(), extract_journal_entry_evidence(), and ensure_journal_evidence_emission_wired() (wiring best-effort journal evidence extraction into DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter.create_decision_journal_entry and AgoraService.create_journal_entry with *args/**kwargs pass-through and WARNING logging on wiring errors). Decision journal entries emit learning evidence only when carrying a decision signal (linked decision lock or decision_id, explicit verdict or evidence kind, or decision/rejection/deferral/intervention tags), returning None and emitting no evidence for plain journal notes without inventing an 'approve' action label. Enforced one evidence item per lock (ev-lock-<human_decision_id>) or decision-bearing journal entry (ev-journal-<entry_id>) with 30-day dataset retention and attached the DatasetRecord and interaction_kind to pending handoffs listed by list_handoffs_for_tenant().
Ensured journal evidence extraction hook is wired when create_dataset_extraction_router() is mounted in the Agora BFF router.
changes.services/agora/service.py: Wired AgoraWriteService.create_decision_lock() to emit one learning evidence item and durable dataset handoff via best-effort _emit_decision_lock_evidence() (catching and logging any dataset-store error so learning evidence extraction failure never fails or blocks a trader decision lock write), logged journal wiring failures at WARNING, and exposed AgoraWriteService.extract_decision_lock_evidence() and extract_journal_entry_evidence().
changes.services/policy-learning/agora_handoff_d: Preserved user_id, interaction_kind, dataset_kind, evidence_ids, and dataset_version/record when forwarding pending Agora dataset handoffs from /internal/agora/dataset-handoffs to /api/policy-learning/agora-handoff.
changes.services/policy-learning/agora_dataset_a: Added interaction_kinds filtering to AgoraDatasetAuthority._select() and list_dataset_versions() plus list_decision_evidence_versions() for decision, rejection, deferral, and intervention records.
changes.services/research/imitation/agora_datase: Extended _sessions_from_content(), _session_target(), build_dataset_payload(), and build_dataset_lineage() to translate decision, rejection, deferral, and intervention DatasetVersions and their decision_time_snapshot into governed IMT-003 trajectory sessions without inventing an 'approve' fallback action label when no action signal is present, and record interaction_kinds in dataset lineage while preserving the >=2 action-label guard in bc_trainer.py.

AC1_four_evidence_kinds_with_decision_ti.proof: TestDecisionLockAndJournalEvidenceExtraction (including test_plain_journal_note_without_decision_signal_produces_no_learn_evidence) in services/control-plane/bff/agora/dataset_extraction/test_extractor.py and test_decision_route_emits_four_learning_evidence_kinds_with_snapshot_one_per_lock, test_decision_succeeds_when_dataset_store_raises_on_evidence_emission, and test_journal_write_path_emits_four_learning_evidence_kinds_and_survives_dataset_store_error in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_shadow_mode.py verify that decision, rejection, deferral, and intervention are extracted from both Agora decision locks (via AgoraWriteService.create_decision_lock) and decision-bearing journal entries (via AgoraService.create_journal_entry and DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter.create_decision_journal_entry) with their decision-time snapshot, that plain journal notes without a decision signal emit no learn evidence and never invent an 'approve' label, and that dataset-store errors never fail or block trader decision locks or journal entries.

AC2_routed_to_learn_and_delivered_by_exi.proof: TestAgoraHandoffDrainer.test_drainer_delivers_four_decision_evidence_kinds_from_locks_and_journal in services/policy-learning/tests/test_agora_handoff_drainer.py emits decision and rejection through AgoraWriteService.create_decision_lock() and deferral and intervention through AgoraService.create_journal_entry() into AgoraDatasetStore, drains /internal/agora/dataset-handoffs via the existing agora_handoff_drainer.process_drainer_cycle(), delivers all 4 items to policy-learning /api/policy-learning/agora-handoff, acknowledges all 4 handoffs on /internal/agora/dataset-handoffs/{id}/ack, and verifies AgoraDatasetAuthority.list_decision_evidence_versions() and build_dataset_payload() produce 4 governed IMT-003 trajectory sessions with decision_time_snapshot.

AC3_one_item_per_lock_or_journal_entry_r.proof: Deterministic evidence IDs (ev-lock-<human_decision_id> and ev-journal-<entry_id>) and scoped idempotency keys (agora-lock-evidence:<tenant>:<user>:<evidence_id> and agora-journal-evidence:<tenant>:<user>:<evidence_id>) enforce exactly one evidence item per lock or journal entry. Retention defaults to DEFAULT_DATASET_RETENTION_DAYS = 30 (existing dataset retention, bounded 1..365 days). Growth per trader per day is stated in DECISION_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_BUDGET and runtime_budget below.

AC4_hosted_proof.in_process_boundary_proof: Verified in test_decision_route_emits_four_learning_evidence_kinds_with_snapshot_one_per_lock and test_drainer_delivers_four_decision_evidence_kinds_from_locks_and_journal: POST /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events/{id}/decisions writes the decision lock via AgoraWriteService.create_decision_lock(), emits one learn DatasetRecord (ev-lock-<human_decision_id>) and one pending handoff, and process_drainer_cycle() delivers it to policy-learning and marks the handoff acknowledged.
AC4_hosted_proof.hosted_plan: After this PR is deployed to hosted dev, submit one trader decision on POST /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events/{id}/decisions (or verify the first dev trader decision lock), read GET /bff/agora/datasets/learn and GET /bff/agora/dataset-worker/handoffs to confirm one delivered evidence item (ev-lock-<human_decision_id>) with ack_status='acknowledged' after the policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler drainer cycle.

runtime_budget.cadence: event-driven on Agora decision lock or decision journal write; drained by existing hourly policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler (agora_handoff_drainer)
runtime_budget.cleanup: Follows existing 30-day dataset retention window enforced by AgoraDatasetStore and AgoraEvidenceStore
